name: rextor-audit[bot]
description: PR-time security audit agent for smart-contract repositories. Every review runs static analyzers (Slither + Aderyn), grounds each finding in cited diff lines, verifies exploitability by forking live chain state, and attests the result on-chain: riskScore 0-100, findings hash (sha256, recomputable from the public report), and an IPFS-pinned report whose gateway fetch hashes to the on-chain value. Reviews may carry suggested fix diffs (suggested-only, never auto-applied). Verdicts are chain-native (attested on Tempo testnet 42431, contract 0x7fe69adeaaaf5fb2344ab14ac0eec42463410bcd); this identity is chain-neutral.
